_note: Registry for the hosted (Docker Compose) setup. Copy to registry/apps.hosted.json and edit; compose mounts that file. Demo instances are containers on the compose network: 'container' is the container name, 'host' is its service name, 'port' is the port INSIDE the container. A demo needs a base app entry (demoOf points at it); the base entry is hidden because only the demo copy is deployed.

demo.notes: No database; sessions expire after 45 minutes
